# hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists the snapshots of a Storage Box, manual and automatic. Only the inclusive **BX10 (100 GB)** Storage Box of a dedicated server is still managed through Robot; every other Storage Box moved to the [Hetzner Console API](https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/hetzner#storage-boxes) (the `hcloud` provider). Every Storage Box write is limited to one request per 5 seconds, which the provider waits out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hetznerrobot_storagebox_snapshots" "backup" {
  storagebox_id = 123456
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storagebox_id` (Number) Storage Box to list.

### Read-Only

- `snapshots` (Attributes List) The snapshots. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `automatic` (Boolean) Whether the snapshot plan created the snapshot.
- `comment` (String) Comment on the snapshot.
- `filesystem_size` (Number) Size of the box's data when the snapshot was taken, in MB.
- `name` (String) Snapshot name.
- `size` (Number) Size of the snapshot in MB.
- `storagebox_id` (Number) Storage Box the snapshot belongs to.
- `timestamp` (String) Creation time in UTC.
